headline: A general contracting business needed to be formally registered before taking on contracts in its own name.
challenge: Contracting clients and partners expect to deal with a registered business. Trading informally limits the contracts a business can bid for and the confidence it can offer.
delivered: Business name registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission under CAMA 2020
Nature of business recorded as general contracts
Principal place of business registered in Lagos State
impact: A formally registered general contracting business, able to present itself to clients and partners under its own registered name.
